summary: Verified two new admin features end-to-end: FULL EDIT of custom questions on Master Pertanyaan and IMPORT PERTANYAAN on Import Data. All flows work as spec. Backend was already verified via curl by main agent; this iteration focused on UI. Login admin/admin123 works. Created custom Balita question 'QA Edit Test' (single, Ya/Tidak) via mq-add-*, then via mq-edit-<kode> the EditModal correctly showed the custom-only fields (mq-edit-section, mq-edit-jenis, mq-edit-opsi). Switching jenis to number hid mq-edit-opsi and revealed mq-edit-satuan; saved with 'kg' -> toast 'Pertanyaan diperbarui' and row now shows 'number (kg)'. Regression: edited built-in BUMIL_SUHU — EditModal correctly did NOT render section/jenis/opsi/satuan; text-only save works with toast. On Import Data page, the third card 'Impor Pertanyaan' (import-pertanyaan) is present; template download returns template_pertanyaan.xlsx; uploaded a valid 1-row xlsx (group=balita, text='QA Import Row', jenis=single, opsi='Ya; Tidak') -> import-pertanyaan-result shows '1 data berhasil diimpor'; the imported question appears in Balita group with correct jenis=single and Opsi 'Ya · Tidak'. Cleanup deleted both QA test rows (BALITA_QA_EDIT_TEST, BALITA_QA_IMPORT_ROW); GET /api/master/questions?group=balita confirms 0 QA rows remain.
